# assignmentB2MarinaLevy

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of assignmentB2MarinaLevy is to demonstrate Marina Levy's ability to create an R Package for STAT545. That being said, assignmentB2MarinaLevy is also a usable R Package with the prebaked (from Grace Palmer, instructor of STAT545) function count_all_missing_by_group which counts missing values by group for a provided data set.

## Installation

You can install the development version of assignmentB2MarinaLevy from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("UBC-STAT545-F2026/assignmentB2MarinaLevy", ref = "1.0")
```

## Example

This is a basic example:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2MarinaLevy)
## basic example code for airquality data by month
count_all_missing_by_group(airquality, Month)
```
